tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light theme: a white with a faint purple bias; dark theme: Floodlight Night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, score cards, table bodies on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, input wells, zebra stripes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (16.7:1 light, 16.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table meta on `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.9:1 light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: imama-green
tokens.usage: The 'imama' green. Text, links and win states on `surface`/`surface-raised` (5.95:1 light, 10.1:1 dark). Use `on-imama-green` for text placed on it.

tokens.name: imama-green-bright
tokens.usage: Top stop of the imama gradient. Large display fills and graphics only; not for small text on light grounds.

tokens.name: imama-green-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the imama gradient.

tokens.name: on-imama-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `imama-green` fill.

tokens.name: league-purple
tokens.usage: The 'UAE IMAMA' / 'SEASON' ink. Primary brand colour: primary buttons, headings, active tabs (10.8:1 on light surface, 8.0:1 on dark). Use `on-league-purple` for text placed on it.

tokens.name: league-purple-bright
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the cricket/league gradient. Display fills and graphics only, never small text.

tokens.name: league-purple-mid
tokens.usage: Midpoint of the cricket/league gradient; secondary graphic fills.

tokens.name: league-purple-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the cricket/league gradient; deepest brand fill.

tokens.name: on-league-purple
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `league-purple` fill (11.6:1 light, 8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Floodlight Night: the ground for reversed logos, broadcast graphics and social posts in both themes.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on `night`.

tokens.name: boundary-gold
tokens.usage: Highlights for 4s, 6s, milestones and the Season 2 trophy moment. A FILL only: put `night` text on it (11.1:1); never gold text on light grounds.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE badge and wicket events. Always paired with the word LIVE or W. White on it in light (5.6:1); `surface` text on it in dark (6.9:1).

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on a `live` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. Solid; 10.8:1 on light surface, 11:1-plus on dark.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Posters and hero headlines. Lowercase, like the wordmark.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Runs/wickets on score cards. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Al Ain Strikers vs Dubai Falcons

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gates open at 6:30 pm. Bring your ticket QR.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, overs, run rate, venue.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Tracked caps that echo the logo's UAE IMAMA / SEASON 2 lines. Eyebrows, badges, table headers. Never longer than ~4 words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Poster margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, table cells, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, score cards, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: LIVE badge, season badge, filter chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised score cards only. Everything else uses a `hairline` border.
